aliasing_method: same seeded balanced cyclic rotation used by the frozen official component-control and corpus-size Pass 1 implementations
alias_balance_rule: Each ordering occupies Candidate A-C exactly four times.
retry_rule: HTTP/API failures stop the run. Only a structurally invalid HTTP-200 response may receive one deterministic retry without changing candidate content.
candidate_body_policy: Apply the frozen build_blind_packets.clean_final function to each COMPLETE source final.txt; this removes evidence maps/appendices exactly as in the prior official Pass 1 packet implementation.
analysis_unit: case mean after averaging three stochastic replicates; n=4 independent cases
scoring_protocol_change: none; only the candidate cardinality changes from four conditions to the three frozen evidence orderings
citation_scope_note: Pass 1 evaluates cleaned final-answer quality and is independent of the separate deterministic citation-attribution analysis.
